body_lead: HYDERABAD: Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka on Saturday called for extensive use of digital technology and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to take Telangana’s tourism sector to international standards and project its natural, historical, spiritual and cultural heritage globally. Speaking at World Tourism Day-2026 celebrations at Shilparamam, themed “Digital Agenda - Reimagining Tourism with Artificial Intelligence”, Bhatti stressed the need to modernise tourism in line with emerging technologies.
